# Embedded emissions not calculated: country of production missing

The ruleset requires three inputs, and one is missing:

| Required input | Provided | Status |
|---|---|---|
| (a) CN code in table | 7207 11 90 (semi-finished products of iron or non-alloy steel) | ✅ Listed |
| (b) Country of production | Not stated. It is on the mill certificate, which was not included. | ❌ Missing |
| (c) Quantity (tonnes) | 3,300 t | ✅ Provided |

Default values depend on both the CN code and the country, and the SEE for 7207 11 90 differs a lot between countries. Under the ruleset I cannot pick a country or estimate a value.

## What I need
Please send the **country of production** from the mill certificate. It must be one of the countries listed for CN 7207 11 90: **Türkiye, China, or India**. If it is any other country, the table has no default value and I still cannot calculate.

## Reference: possible outcomes (not a calculation result)
Once you confirm the country, the calculation is SEE × 3,300 t:

| Country | Default SEE (tCO2e/t) | Embedded emissions (tCO2e) |
|---|---|---|
| Türkiye | 3.087 | 10,187.10 |
| China | 3.314 | 10,936.20 |
| India | 4.32 | 14,256.00 |

These figures are conditional and must not be used for the CBAM declaration until the mill certificate confirms the country. When you send it, I'll give you the final figure.
